research_rationale: Read full ORIGINAL:EO:13283 chars 0-6535, all three own-term leads, full ACTOR_TEXT:EO:13385 chars 0-9941, actor provisions, chain, searches and missing list. ORIGINAL §§1-7 establish and regulate the Office; temporary communicator teams and funding/personnel qualifications do not terminate the Office on an earlier date. Original §3(a) reference to EO:12333 only excludes special activities from the assessment mandate, so the missing target-provision pointer is not an unresolved lifecycle gap. Independent authorities protected in §§5-6 remain preexisting authorities, while the agency-assistance duty is tied to the Office mission. EO:13385 §9 (ACT:EO:13283>EO:13385 chars 9619-9652) unconditionally revokes this order, and §10 (acting-order effective-date evidence, chars 9663-9712) expressly makes the order effective September 30, 2005, rather than its September 29 signing date. No savings qualification applies. Read the held bounded catalog search of disposition notes and saved order texts and eCFR search; neither supplies an earlier end or a continuation lead beyond this unconditional revocation. USC search has a 2026-10-09 currency limit and is not used to assert an October 14 current predicate. Corrected inventory removes empty headings, separable page furniture and signature, preserving all operative original provisions. This is a local producer draft for review pending complete GitHub freeze, not publication or human review.
